themes_detail.label: Mysterious Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints surged to 3 complaints 3 weeks ago from a baseline of 0.1 per week over 8 weeks (2300% spike, z-score 8.69), representing the most statistically extreme outlier in the district's 311 data—suggesting either a single major incident, organized tree-cutting activity, or a reporting surge worth urgent investigation.
evidence: 3 illegal tree damage complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% spike)
Z-score of 8.69 indicates this is the most extreme statistical anomaly in the dataset
No recent local news coverage of tree damage in district, suggesting story has not been picked up
reporting_angles: Investigate which trees were damaged, where, and by whom—contact Parks Department for incident reports
Interview residents about whether they witnessed organized tree-cutting or if this was storm-related damage
Examine whether this spike was concentrated in one neighborhood or spread across Fordham/University Heights

themes_detail.label: Lead Contamination Alerts This Week
themes_detail.summary: Lead complaints jumped to 4 in the past week, up 967% from a baseline of 0.4 per week (z-score 7.49), marking a significant public health concern in a district with ongoing air quality and environmental health requests—warrants immediate investigation of source and affected buildings.
evidence: 4 lead complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% increase)
Z-score of 7.49 indicates statistically extreme spike in lead-related concerns
Community board has standing request to investigate air quality complaints at specific locations, suggesting prior environmental concerns
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings or addresses generated the 4 lead complaints and whether they share common characteristics (age, prior violations, etc.)
Interview Health Department about what triggered the spike and whether this reflects new testing or new contamination
Reach out to affected families about symptoms, testing history, and remediation efforts

themes_detail.label: Commercial Noise Surge in Fordham
themes_detail.summary: Commercial noise complaints more than doubled this week to 22 complaints from a baseline of 8.4 per week (163% spike, z-score 3.68), suggesting new or intensified business activity, construction, or events disrupting residential areas.
evidence: 22 commercial noise complaints last week vs. 8.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (163% increase)
Z-score of 3.68 indicates statistically significant deviation
Residential noise complaints (2879 total over 90 days) remain the second-largest complaint category, indicating noise is a chronic district problem
reporting_angles: Map the 22 commercial noise complaints geographically—are they clustered near a specific business, venue, or construction site?
Interview business owners and residents about what changed recently (new bar opening, late-night delivery schedule, construction schedule shift)
Cross-reference with DOB permits: are any of the 265 recent alteration filings in noisy trades (commercial kitchens, HVAC, loading docks)?

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Stress Signals
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints doubled this week to 8 complaints from a baseline of 3.6 per week (121% spike, z-score 3.11), combined with significant water leak complaints (569 over 90 days) and heat/hot water complaints (3334), suggesting possible infrastructure strain or seasonal issues worth monitoring.
evidence: 8 sewer complaints last week vs. 3.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (121% increase)
Z-score of 3.11 indicates statistically significant spike
569 water leak complaints over 90 days and 964 plumbing complaints suggest broader water infrastructure challenges
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Environmental Protection about whether sewer system maintenance or emergencies are underway in Fordham/University Heights
Interview residents and building managers about sewage backups, flooding, or water quality issues to contextualize complaints
Investigate whether sewer spikes correlate with recent DOB alterations (146 filed in 90 days) that may have disrupted underground utilities

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Surge Two Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: For-hire vehicle complaints spiked to 8 two weeks ago from a baseline of 2.9 per week (178% increase, z-score 3.53), indicating possible new Uber/Lyft activity, illegal vehicle use, or traffic congestion concentrated in this district.
evidence: 8 for-hire vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 2.9 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (178% increase)
Z-score of 3.53 indicates statistically significant spike
Illegal parking complaints (2410 over 90 days) remain top-3 concern, suggesting vehicle-related issues are chronic in district
reporting_angles: Interview TLC and Uber/Lyft about whether new drivers or surge pricing events activated in this district 2 weeks ago
Canvass residents near Fordham Road and major intersections about whether they notice increased vehicle congestion or illegal parking
Check whether spike correlates with university events or seasonal demand changes at Fordham University
